summary: The customer asks for written confirmation that an NIR system will measure granulate moisture to ±0.1%, a guarantee of regulatory approval for release testing, and pricing for a complete system.

facts_stated.text: The customer is evaluating a purchase.
The sample material is a granulate.

targets.enquiry_quote: measure the moisture of our granulate to plus or minus 0.1 % and guarantee that our regulator will approve it for release testing

customer_premises.claim: An NIR system can be guaranteed in writing to achieve ±0.1% accuracy for granulate moisture prior to feasibility testing and calibration.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: confirm in writing that your NIR system will measure the moisture of our granulate to plus or minus 0.1 %

customer_premises.claim: Equipment vendor can guarantee regulatory approval of the method for release testing.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: guarantee that our regulator will approve it for release testing

unknowns: Granulate composition, active ingredients, and excipient matrix
Moisture range and required calibration reference method (e.g., Karl Fischer, loss on drying)
Particle size, distribution, and surface characteristics
Installation configuration (in-line, on-line, or at-line) and presentation interface
Process conditions including temperature, pressure, and ambient humidity
